decisions.statement: Nothing here reads a call's words, which the one argument reader does.
A fault is said in one line.
A run of blank space in a fault's message is made one space.
A thrown thing that is no error is said as the text of that thrown thing.
A staged folder nothing named is a fresh folder under /var/tmp.
A staged folder the caller named is made where no folder is at that path.
A staged folder is answered as the real path of that folder.
Nothing here writes into the folder staged.
A staged folder this made is named to the caller as soon as it is made.
A folder already there is named by nothing, since nothing made it.

definition: a fault said in one line, and a folder staged to write into
